method.ast: ast.parse of the decoded text; functions = FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef; classes = ClassDef

method.determinism: static section contains no timestamps or environment-dependent values; canonical JSON is sort_keys=True, indent=2, ASCII-escaped, one trailing LF, and is byte-identical between two runs on the same revision
method.import_edges: ast.ImportFrom with level == 1, first dotted segment of node.module

adversarial_cases: non-UTF-8 bytes in a target file: recorded as an explicit error entry {path, reason}; never coerced to zero definitions
CRLF vs LF line endings: lines are physical splitlines() and are line-ending agnostic; raw bytes remain the authoritative identity
very long line: causes an explicit error entry (bounded-line rule); never truncation and never a silent zero count
path containing spaces: accepted as an opaque repository-relative POSIX path; path is emitted verbatim in the record
unreadable or missing path: explicit error entry; the module row is absent, never filled with zeros
malformed_input_contract.declaration: Fail-closed measurement contract: a target file that is unreadable, not representable as UTF-8, unparseable by ast.parse, or whose physical line exceeds the documented bound is recorded as an explicit error entry {path, reason, stage} in the top-level errors array. The affected module row is ABSENT and the record status is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; the measurement is never silently coerced to a zero-count or empty record, and no file is skipped silently.
malformed_input_contract.decode_rule: bytes are measured exactly from raw on-disk bytes; for line counting only, UTF-8 decode uses errors="replace" as declared; if replacement characters occur the file gets an error entry rather than a silent line count
malformed_input_contract.error_entry_shape: {path: repository-relative POSIX path, reason: short deterministic token such as unreadable|not_utf8|ast_parse_failed|line_too_long, stage: bytes|lines|ast}
malformed_input_contract.generator_note: The generator is described in README.md, not shipped as a repository script. The error-entry behaviour is therefore declared by contract here and is NOT demonstrated by a shipped executable in this record; the later generator-producing slice must ship it and exercise the adversarial cases above (Stage D B-2 correction).
